Throughout this document, the terms “s hall” and “will” are used to identify specific f unctions and capabilities that Pontis 5.0 must provide (e.g., Pontis inspection interface shall provide the ability to perform data validation on National Bridge Invento ry items).

The terms “ may” a nd “ might” are used to indicate functions and c apabilities that ma y or may not be included in the final product (e.g., Pontis may provide a dire ct link to GIS soft ware for map-based querying).
